column1: # What the DAST check (checks.yml, dast) does with each ZAP rule: a finding
# of a rule set to FAIL fails the check, and so does one of any rule not
# listed here, since every warning counts. The rules below are accepted on
# purpose, each with the reason; changing this file needs a maintainer.
# Format: rule id, tab, IGNORE or INFO or WARN or FAIL, tab, reason.

column3: (CSP: connect-src https: and style-src 'unsafe-inline') The browser checks that the panel opens by its domain, another origin known only after the page was loaded (the first setup), so connect-src allows https: rather than one origin. Scripts are pinned by hash, so nothing foreign can run to use the wider reach. React and Radix position elements with inline style attributes.
(Private IP Disclosure) 172.17.0.1 is Docker's default gateway, named in a hint about Nginx Proxy Manager, not an address of this server.
(Storable and Cacheable Content) The scripts and fonts are content-hashed and cached on purpose; pages are sent with no-cache.
(Modern Web Application) Informational: the panel is a single-page application.
